description: A shell script for managing Kubernetes addons, including functions for logging, resource reconciliation, leader election, and pruning whitelist generation.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs messages at different levels (INFO, WRN, ERR) with optional timestamp.

methods.name: generate_prune_allowlist_flags
methods.description: Generates command-line flags for pruning resources based on a list.

methods.name: start_addon
methods.description: Starts an addon from a file with retries.

methods.name: create_resource_from_string
methods.description: Creates a Kubernetes resource from a YAML/JSON string with retries.

methods.name: reconcile_resource_from_string
methods.description: Reconciles a resource in Kubernetes from a string, applying with label 'Reconcile'.

methods.name: ensure_resource_from_string
methods.description: Ensures a resource exists in Kubernetes from a string, creating with label 'EnsureExists'.

methods.name: reconcile_addons
methods.description: Reconciles Kubernetes addons using labels and pruning.

methods.name: is_leader
methods.description: Determines if the current node is the leader in a multi-master setup using leader election.
